facts.text: I am preparing for an upcoming trade show in Chicago.
I need help designing my booth for the trade show in Chicago.
I recently returned from a super successful conference.
At the conference, I collected over 200 contact details from potential clients and partners.
At the conference, potential clients and partners expressed interest in our products.
I am thinking of using a similar layout to what I had at the conference.
I want to generate interest in our products using the conference layout.
I want to evolve my booth design and add a twist to make it more engaging for the trade show.
I want to build on the momentum from collecting over 200 contact details.
I want to decide whether to prioritize lead generation or product demos at the trade show.
I plan to have a combination of both lead-generation-focused activities and product demo stations at the trade show.
I plan to offer a free consultation or trial of our product to attendees who provide their contact information.
I plan to have a demo station where attendees can see the product in action.
I plan to have team members from our sales and product teams manning the demo station.
The team members at the demo station will conduct the demos.
The team members at the demo station will answer questions.
The team members at the demo station will capture lead information.
I plan to set up tablets with our CRM system to capture lead information quickly.
I plan to use the CRM system on tablets to capture lead information and follow up after the show.
I plan to have a dedicated team member responsible for sending follow-up emails and making phone calls to leads generated at the show.
I plan to use our marketing automation platform to send targeted email campaigns to leads based on their interests and interactions with our product.
I plan to schedule a series of follow-up meetings and demos with the most promising leads.
The follow-up meetings and demos will be handled by my sales team.
I plan to send personalized emails and letters to the leads.
The personalized emails and letters will highlight the benefits of our product.
The personalized emails and letters will explain how our product can solve specific pain points.
